films.title: Thirty seconds in the agent space
films.line: A visitor asks Odin what is going on and Atlas how to plug in an agent. Each answer comes with its proof card: the question, the answer, why, and the source.

source.note: Recorded in the agent space's own viewer and copied here unchanged, with its poster frame.

films.title: A tour of the agent space
films.line: A visitor walks in through the arch and asks three agents a question: Odin what is going on and how he knows, Atlas how to plug in an agent, Pulse how long it has been running. Every answer comes with its proof card.
films.real: A live session, recorded unedited; Pulse is a separate HTTP service answering from its own process.

source.note: Recorded in the agent space's own viewer and copied here unchanged, with its poster frame.
